summary.keyFinding: ZERO PLANNING_STRATEGIC_SOURCE. The 16 CI-W1C.7.3 anchors were ALL legacy positive (12 LEGACY_VISUAL_EVIDENCE + 2 VISUAL_DIAGNOSIS + 1 CREATIVE_HYPOTHESIS). The 4 legitimate planning-positive anchors (S01, S04-S06) are all placeholders / constraints, not strategy. Notably: the A15 creativeDecision block (a G02-specific rich source) is classified as CREATIVE_HYPOTHESIS not PLANNING — it is a VUC-generated creative proposal, not a human-authored planning document.
